articles.title: Prepare Yourself for His Advent
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Srila Gurudev emphasizes on removing all the desires from the heart other than Krishna's service. He narrates various topics like, Haridas Thakur’s grace on the infantrymen signifying the strength and power of Vaishnava’s grace, eligibility for staying in Dham and who can have real darshan of Dham, how Krishna’s advent is not like the birth of any ordinary enslaved jiva, the anarthas we have in our heart and how to remove them and the significance of Gundicha-marjan.

blocks.text: No one can enter in Vrindavan-Dham without the grace of Lord Vrindavan-chandra's personal associates. If someone has committed an offence, he cannot enter in Vrindavan. How will he be able to enter? It will be possible only by the grace of Vaishnava. Vaishnava's grace is topmost and anything can be possible by it. Haridas Thakur was cruelly flogged with a cane in twenty two markets by infantrymen. Supreme Lord was eager to appear to protect him. But Haridas Thakur prayed to Him, “These infantrymen do not have any knowledge about what they are doing. Please be merciful on them. Do not take their offence.” The grace of Vaishnava is so strong that though Lord Himself had come to punish them but as Haridas Thakur prayed for them, Supreme Lord did not take any action against them.

It is been said, jaha kaam taha nahi rama, ravi rajni mile nahi ektham—as day and night cannot exist together, if a votary has material desires in his heart, Supreme Lord does not appear there. Sun and darkness cannot exist together. Wherever there is a presence of desires to satisfy our own senses, Supreme Lord, His holy abode, His form, qualities and associates will never manifest. Externally, we are in Vrindavan-Dham but actually we have not got any contact with Vrindavan-Dham yet.

Tomorrow, Krishna will appear. He appears in Mathura. By the influence of Yogamaya, Vasudeva takes Him to Gokula from Mathura and brings Yogamaya to Mathura. Sri Rupa Goswami has written, vaikuṇṭhāj janito varā madhu-purī—the holy place Mathura is spiritually superior to Vaikuntha because Supreme Lord appears there. Though, He is Supreme Lord Himself, He takes birth to award His service to Devaki-Vasudeva and Yashoda-Nanda Maharaj in parental mood. He appears by accepting them as His parents. Dasharath Maharaj and Kaushalya Devi do not give birth to Ramchandra. Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda or Vasudeva and Devaki do not give birth to Krishna. By the prayers of Devaki and Vasudeva, He accepts to appear as their son. First He appears as four-handed Nayaran, holding a conch shell, disc, club and lotus in His hands. He does not come out from mother's womb like an ordinary child. By the request of Vasudeva and Devaki He then takes the two handed form as Krishna.

Krishna performs His childhood pastimes in Gokula. Everything resides in Him. Nothing is outside Him. Superior to Mathura is the transcendental forest of Vrindavan, because of Krishna's rasa-lila pastimes. And Govardhan is superior to Vrindavan and superior to Govardhan is the super-excellent Radhakunda which stands supreme because of the mellows of the pastimes performed there. Even today, Krishna is performing His Pastimes in Vrindavan. His pastimes are going on continuously. It is written in Chaitanya Charitamrita, ‘adyapi sei lila kare krsna-ray, kono kono bhagyavane dekhivare paya’ — Sri Krishna is performing His pastimes even today also but only the fortunate ones could behold them. He is performing His pastimes today also, but a person like me who has material desires, desires other than Sri Krishna filled in his heart, is bereft of beholding them. Such a person, even being in Vrindavan, will be deprived of that vision and for them Vrindavan is covered by Maya—the external potency of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna.

Once a person asked Bhaktivinoda Thakur, “Nabadwip Dham is non-different from Gauranga Mahaprabhu—the manifestation of magnanimity. He rescued many fallen soul here. His abode (Dham) is also merciful like Him. But then why many people, even while staying in the Dham perform abominable acts?”

Bhaktivinoda Thakur replied, “Supreme Lord has innumerable potencies, amongst them three are the main—antaranga (internal potency), bahiranga (material/external potency) and tatastha. The holy abodes like Vaikuntha, Goloka-Vrindavan manifest from the internal potency (also called chida-shakti) of the Lord. This material world comes from the external potency of the Lord. It is a prison house for conditional souls who have forgotten Krishna and have desires for sensual enjoyment. They tremendously suffer from three kinds of miseries. This external potency also belongs to Supreme Lord only, it is non-different from Him, but it is vimukh-mohini (mahamaya)—the potency which envelops the jivas and makes them averse to the Supreme Lord, fully engrossed in this material world. The other one is unmukha-toshani (antaranga-shakti)—the internal potency in the form of shuddha-bhakta (pure devotees) who take those jivas to the Supreme Lord who are inclined to Him. Supreme Lord's name, form, attributes, pastimes and associates are non-different from each other. They all reside in Him. His abode is non-different from Him. Out of illusion, a person who is averse to the Supreme Lord may also think that he is staying in Vrindavan and is in contact with the Dham but actually he is not in contact. He is outside the Dham. Dham is covered by Lord's external potency. Such a person remains in that illusory covering and performs all the abominable acts. The holy abode of the Supreme Lord is transcendental and everything there, every object which is used for the service of Krishna is also transcendental.”

We have heard about it on the advent day of Baladeva. Baladeva serves Lord Krishna by assuming ten forms, the Lord’s umbrella, flute, slippers, bedding, pillow, garments, easy chair, residence, sacred thread and throne. Lord's residence, the house is also transcendental, it can walk and also can talk. Common people do not believe this, how a house can talk? They think we are speaking a lie. With our material eyes, we see it as a common material house, but everything there is transcendental. The house is also transcendental and can talk. The flute is also transcendental. The flute of the Lord appeared as Vamsivadanananda Thakur to enrich Mahaprabhu's pastime taking the form of a human. He is non-different from the flute; he walks, and talks and does all the activities.

Everything is transcendental there, and by extending His potency Balaram serves Krishna—satta-vistarini-shakti. All the objects meant for the service of Krishna, are Baladeva-tattva. Even the deity (vigrah) of Krishna is also Baladeva-tattva. Baladeva is sandhini-shakti-matta-vigrah, Krishna is samvita-shakti-matta-vigrah and Radharani is hladini-shakti-matta-vigrah. So these are the three primeval potencies of the Lord—sandhini, samvita and hladini. Here, in the Dham everything belongs to Krishna and is transcendental. We cannot enter in Dham with this gross material body. Only with the transcendental body, one can enter in the transcendental realm.

Now, what should we do on Adhivasa Tithi? Adhivasa is a preliminary function before the main function. Tomorrow, Supreme Lord will appear so we have to make ourselves ready for it. Supreme Lord is equal to all. He has bestowed grace upon Dhruva, Prahald and Amrish Maharaj and He would not bestow grace upon me, it is not like that. Supreme Lord says in Gita,
“I am equal to all. I envy no one. But whoever renders service unto Me in devotion is a friend, is in Me and also I am in him.’

Tomorrow is the advent day of Krishna, we have heard from our Guruvarga that Krishna's advent pastime is eternal. Supreme Lord comes to rescue the fallen souls of the Brahmanda. There are infinite Brahmandas and Supreme Lord’s manifestations are also infinite. There are infinite Vaikunthas and infinite jivas, everything of Him is infinite. No one can comprehend Him fully. If anybody can comprehend Him fully then His name ‘anant—infinite’ will not have any meaning. How many Vaikunthas do you know about? We have heard a very little about them from the scriptures. There are infinite Vaikunthas in which He performs His pastimes in infinite forms. Now, here in this universe He going to perform His appearance pastimes, after appearance He will play the pastimes of an infant, then childhood pastimes and then youth pastimes. There are infinite pastimes. One pastime finishes in this universe and immediately that pastime will start in another universe; this will continue without any interruption. Therefore, it is called nitya-lila—eternal pastimes. There is one more meaning of nitya-lila, we have heard from our Guruvarga which we need to understand. Tomorrow, Supreme Lord will bless someone, a devotee with pure heart, by appearing in his heart. He will reveal Himself in someone’s heart tomorrow. And what happens when the Lord appears?

lines: yasmin vijñate sarvam idam vijñatam bhavati
yasmin prapte sarvam idam praptam bhavati

blocks.text: “By knowing and gaining whom we know and gain everything.”
“Upon gaining whom, nothing remains to be gained further. Being situated in such a position, one is never shaken, even in the midst of the greatest difficulty.”

He is the Supreme Lord Himself and when Supreme Lord descends, there cannot exist of any problem. Until the time He has not descended, we have all the difficulties. And in whose heart will He descend? It is written by Vedavyas Muni in the fourth canto of Srimad Bhagavatam, before the starting of Dhruva-charitra. Shivaji, who is our guru, has said about this,
“I offer my obeisances to the Supreme Lord Vāsudeva who manifests only in the sanctified pure heart which is called Vasudeva.”

Lord Vāsudeva appears accepting Vasudeva. And who is Vasudeva? A sanctified pure heart devoid of any vanity is Vasudeva. Our heart can be sanctified by the grace of Balaram who kills Dhenukasura which represents our misconception of self. We misidentify ourselves with the material body and get engaged in various kinds of sinful and abominable acts. I have forgotten who I am. Who is the Absolute truth and what relation I have got with Him? I have forgotten the original form of the Holy name, the form of the Absolute Truth and the original form of myself. I have forgotten what the goal of life is and what is the path to achieve that goal? Everything I have forgotten like a dumb donkey. By achieving material knowledge, one does not become a scholar. Bhaktivinoda Thakur writes in one of his Kirtan,

“All sorts of material knowledge are variegated forms of your illusory energy which creates impediments on the path of your worship. Such knowledge creates attachment for these perishable worldly relations and makes an ass out of the living entity.”

What is the use of that material knowledge by which I have become averse to the Supreme Lord, I have forgotten my relation with Him and got entangled in the perishable objects of this material world and completely engrossed in ignorance. One who possesses only material knowledge and depriving himself of the transcendental knowledge, his condition is exactly like a donkey who carries the heavy burden of the non-eternal, material world on its back. Lord Baladeva appears to kill that ass, Dhenukasara, which is residing in us. Without the grace of Baladeva, how is it possible to kill Dhenukasura? There is one more demon who resides along with Dhenukasura in our heart, Pralambasura. Pralambasura is a symbol of illicit sexual connection, aspiration for gain, adoration (labha-puja) and name and fame (pratishtha). Unless and until these traits which are signified by Pralambasura are not destroyed, the Supreme Lord will not descend in our heart. Till the time our heart is impure, He will not descend.
On one occasion in Agartala, I remembered the verse recited by Chaitanya Mahaprabhu,

lines: (Chaitanya Charitamrita Madya 11.8 from Sri Chaitanya Chandrodaya Nataka 8.23)

blocks.text: We have taken shelter of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and He Himself has said the above verse. We came here to perform haribhajan by leaving everything, body and bodily relations and material desires. For a niṣkiṣcana—a person who has renounced the material world to perform haribhajan and to cross over the ocean of nescience, it is very dangerous, even more than consuming poison, to be in contact with material sense objects with a desire of enjoying them or to become intimately related with women. By consuming poison, one may lose his body only, but if the poison of material enjoyment enters one's heart then he would be in a great trouble for life after life. If such desires are then in the heart then he will be born again in this world. You have left everything with a desire to engage all your senses in the service of the Supreme Lord. You have observed the appearance day of Lord Baladeva, but Pralambasura is still residing in your heart, desire for illicit sex, the desires for non-eternal, is still there so you will not get the desired fruit until your heart becomes pure. Lord will not appear there. So for one who wants to cross over the ocean of nescience, he should refrain himself from the desire of enjoying material sense objects. We should always remember the last instruction of our Gurudev. If you pocket the money you have got from others for the service of the Supreme Lord then that money will make you fall into a ditch. You have come here to perform bhajan under the shelter of Supreme Lord; will Supreme Lord not protect you? Why you should preserve money for yourself? If you go to an ordinary person of this world and serve him without asking anything, not even food for yourself, then how many days that person will remain silent, he will surely think about you before having his meal, “How can I eat without giving him food, he is serving me so sincerely”. He will surely offer food to you and will say, “Please have it.” Even a bad person of this world cannot remain thinking about you, if you serve him sincerely without asking anything. He himself will take care of your requirements, food, clothes etc. Even a worldly person, not even a good person, if you take the shelter of a bad person of this world, he will protect you then if you take shelter of Supreme Lord who is the master of infinite universes and opulence will He not protect you? If, on the name of Lord, we pocket things for ourselves then where is the sharanagati, surrender? Our Guruvarga, Sanatan Goswami has given us instruction through his servant Ishana, though Ishana did not carry gold coins for himself, he brought it for the service of Sanatan Goswami. Ishana had brought eight gold coins with him. But when Sanatan Goswami asked, “Do you have anything valuable with you?” Then he replied, “I have seven gold coins with me.” Sanatan Goswami gave those gold coins to the landlord. The landlord told to Sanatan Goswami, “Before you offered them, I already knew that there were eight coins in your servant's possession. It is very good that you have voluntarily offered them to me; otherwise I would have killed you and taken your coins. I am now relieved from such sinful activity.” Sanatan Goswami did not trust his words since there is no guarantee in the mind-set of a malicious person. He chastised his servant Ishana, “saṅge kene āniyācha ei kāla-yama?”—why have you brought this death knell with you? What is the teaching our Guru Sanatan Goswami giving here? We do not think about it. He told Ishana, “You have given seven gold coins, one coin you have kept with you, do you still believe that gold coin will protect you? Being a renunciate, if you come with such a mindset then everything will be futile, you will not get success. Take the coin and return to your house. You are not fit and competent to renounce the house.”

We can do many things secretly, but the Supreme Lord sees everything, He is omniscient and omnipotent. He knows everything; you cannot do any abominable or good act hiding from Him. When the Supreme Lord is there to protect and maintain us then why do we have to fear? Supreme Lord tries to give whatever is the necessity for a devotee, yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham. But a devotee does want to take any service from the Lord, his only desire is to serve Him. So, today you have to sanctify your heart. You have to remove whatever desires you have in your heart related to the non-eternal material things. Mahaprabhu has instructed us this through Gundicha Marjan Pastimes. You want to make Jagannath sit in our heart, you go to have His darshan, and you pull the chariot to bring Him to Gundicha. If you want to make Him sit in your heart then you have to make your heart Vrindavan, "mora man mora nahi, mora man vrindavan" — my heart is now not with me it has become Vrindavan. Jagannath is Krishna Himself, He will come and sit in Gundicha, so you have to clean Gundicha. Gundicha represents your heart. We clean it externally but inside we have so many desires other than Krishna. We want material benefits after death by performing karmakanda—fruitive activities. We have desire to get salvation and perfections. We want name and fame. So many things are there in our heart. With the help of the broom, throw everything out from your heart. Clean the temple of your heart, Jagannath will come in that temple of your heart. Perform Gundicha Mandir Marjan with Sankirtan. Perform Sankirtan without tenfold offence. Today we should perform Sankirtan.

articles.title: On Sri Krishna’s Appearance
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: In the beginning of this harikatha, Srila Gurudev narrates about sanctifying our hearts for the advent of the Supreme Lord, Sri Krishna. By narrating Srila Prabhupad’s ‘vaishnav ke’ kirtan, he advices us for not getting inclined to nirjan-bhajan and be always in association of the devotees which will rescue us from our spiritual fall down. In the later part, he narrates the advent pastimes of the Supreme Lord Krishna in detail and he concludes by emphasizing on the importance of listening about the Lord’s advent, His name, form, qualities, about His associates and about His other pastimes.

blocks.text: I heard about the successful celebration of Janmashtami in Vienna. Through a letter I got from Slovenia, I have come to learn that all the devotees attended the meeting there. Here also, in Kolkata, the annual function is held twice in a year, one on the occasion of Janmashtami, the holy appearance day of Nandnandan Sri Krishna and the other on the occasion of the installation of the presiding deities in Kolkata Math during winter season in the month of January. It is a big function of five days. People in huge numbers from Kolkata metropolis and other districts, towns and villages attended the celebration. The Math was packed full. Our Guru Maharaj introduced it.

It is important that you should perform ‘Adhivas’, preliminary function, one day earlier. Adhivas is preparing yourself, all arrangements should be done for puja, ritualistic performances before Krishna’s appearance. The main reason for observing Adhivas is to sanctify the heart. In Srimad Bhagavatam, 4th canto, Mahadeva has said about who Vasudeva is:
“I offer my obeisances to the Supreme Lord, Vasudeva who manifests only in the sanctified pure heart which is called Vasudeva.”

The Supreme Lord’s functions and all pastimes are eternal. There are infinite Brahmandas. The Supreme Lord is infinite, so all the products of His potency are also infinite. Nobody can comprehend them fully. Nobody can say that I have already seen everything and narrated everything about Sri Krishna. If anybody says like that then he has got no knowledge of the Supreme Lord. There are infinite spirit souls, infinite Brahmandas, infinite Vaikunthas—transcendental spiritual realms. He also manifests in infinite forms, but the origin of all the forms, Nandnandan Sri Krishna, is the highest. Highest and all delightful relations are with Nandnandan Krishna. You can love Sri Krishna with all kinds of delightful relations. Mainly five (shant, dashya, sakhya, vatsalya and madhurya), but the mixture of them make infinite combinations. It is by permutations and combinations, the mathematical way of understanding. Everything is infinite there. Prior to the appearance day of the Supreme Lord Sri Krishna is the preliminary function. Our Gurudev said that you have to perform Nagar Sankirtan on this day. You have to sanctify your heart. God’s appearance is eternal in the sense that in infinite Brahmandas, all pastimes like appearance, childhood, boyhood etc. are going on (when one pastime gets finished in one Brahmanda the same will start in another Brahmanda). In another sense, God will appear in the heart of some blessed devotees on that day. We are not sanctified yet. Sattvaṁ viśuddhaṁ vasudeva-śabditaṁ — He appears in the sanctified heart (viśuddha-satva) only.

There is satva-guna in the primal qualities of the material energy—satva(mode of goodness), rajas(mode of passion) and tamah(mode of ignorance). But this satva is mixed with rajas and tamah. Viśuddha-satva means there is no connection with the gunas, it is nirgun i.e. purely transcendental, completely transcendental, aprakrita — beyond comprehension. With human sense organs—gross and subtle, you cannot comprehend it. It is a finest region, very blissful. The Supreme Lord has got a form; He can take the initiative. In Vedic culture, you have to note very carefully, nothing can be preserved or retained without consciousness. Matter can do nothing. As long as consciousness exists in the body, the body will remain. When consciousness leaves the body, you may try to preserve it for a long time, chemically, but there is no person there. The person is attributed to conscious principle—thinking, feeling and willing. Nobody considers a dead body as a person. Everywhere in this world we see all the living beings, including human beings, are doing all activities through consciousness, by thinking, feeling and willing. Even in this material world, there are many atheist persons who don’t believe in the existence of Atma or Paramatma, but when Atma leaves the body they also don't consider the dead body to be the person. Even if they touch the dead body they take a bath. In Vedic culture, the Sun is God. You are not seeing that, you are seeing the material form. Without consciousness it cannot be retained. This building is constructed. As long as conscious beings are here it will be maintained, if they leave this, after four-five hundred or may be one thousand years it will perish. Nothing can be retained without consciousness. The Supreme Lord is the source of all conscious beings. He can take initiative. He is not inert. He is All-Powerful, All-Existence, All-Knowledge and All-Bliss. Without His grace, as there is no one equal or more than Him, nobody can get Him. If anybody tries to do this, by using reasoning and arguments, it will be a total failure. With a challenging mood you cannot get any idea of the Supreme Lord.

We are not the prime cause. It is written in Taittiriya Upanishad (3.1.1), yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante — everything is coming from the Supreme Lord. All the jivas are emerging from Brahma, and Brahma is sustained by the Supreme Lord. The Supreme Lord is the prime cause. He is controlling everything. In a moment He can create infinite Brahmands. In a moment He can destroy them. We may have much so-called vanity, false vanity, that we have done this, we have done that. It is nothing. In regards to the Supreme Lord, He is omniscient. But human beings are not omniscient. As much power is given to them so much they can do (imparted power). We are always to remember Swami Maharaj's saying in explanation of one verse of Gita with deep thought—when one is enlightened with the knowledge, by that ignorance is destroyed and his knowledge reveals everything as Sun lights up everything at day time. We try to see things by our material sense organs so this instance has been given. Supreme Lord has infinite knowledge. He is self-effulgent. If the Supreme Lord appears in you, you will have your own knowledge; you will see everything in proper perspective. You will also be omniscient. But once you get it, you cannot keep your body here (After having the real knowledge, you will not be able to live away from the Supreme Lord). As long as the Supreme Lord wants that this person should remain here, He will not appear fully before him. Once a person gets the realization of the Supreme Lord, his existence is fully finished in this world. He cannot remain here. Only by the Lord’s desire, if He sends somebody, they can remain, otherwise not.

So you have to sanctify your heart. Vasudeva means sanctified heart, pure heart. Even with the heart filled with many worldly things, if you call God and if He comes, He will think, “Oh! His heart is already filled; I have got no place to stay.” He will go back. You have to clear everything from the heart. Can you clear yours? You pass through millions of births, those previous thoughts (impressions) are going on. For that reason, our Param Gurudev, Srila Saraswati Goswami Thakur, who is the personal associate and the grace incarnate form of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna, Gaurang Mahaprabhu, has written about not going for nirjan-bhajan (doing devotion in a secluded place). There were some devotees who, without taking permission from him, went for worship in a lonely place. Performing devotion without associating with devotees is called nirjan-bhajan. No Vaishnav or anybody else has previously said anything against nirjan-bhajan. But Prabhupad said, “If you are neophyte and want your eternal welfare then you should stay in the company of bona fide sadhus. The atmosphere in Kaliyuga is not congenial for doing lonely bhajan and your previous evil thoughts are also flowing constantly within your mind, like an undercurrent river flow in Gaya (it is called Phalgu—not seen outside). If you remain in lonely place and do anything wrong, any evil action, who will see you? So don’t do this.”
A few disciple of Srila Saraswati Prabhupad went in seclusion for performing devotion without asking his permission. Srila Prabhupad then advised them to not do so. He has written,

We should not think that we have become Vaishnavas. Srila Prabhupad says, “Oh! Wicked mind, with this sort of vanity that 'you have become a Vaishnava’, you will not get actual spiritual, devotional benefit. Your worship in loneliness is deceitfulness, nothing else.” He himself has written, and our Krishna Das Babaji Maharaj used to sing this hymn. I don't want to elaborately discuss this, but, by the by,

“You are propagating the solitary worship — kuyogī-vaibhava, the wealth of the indecent yogis. Conditioned souls of this world may be attracted to the wealth of such yogis but the real devotee will not. You are a neophyte.”

lines: sei du'ti kathā, bhula' nā sarvathā

blocks.text: “You do Sankirtan loudly from the core of the heart by remaining in the association of Sadhus. Because if you remain in a lonely place then the imbibed thoughts of millions of births will come in your mind. And if you do an abominable act, who will rescue you?”

“You are not eligible for nirjan-bhajan. When by Kirtan you will be surcharged with the remembrance of Krishna, then you can do nirjan-bhajan.”
Now if you go for nirjan-bhajan, just the reverse is what you will get. With all this knowledge they (our Guruvarga) have established Math, not unnecessarily they have done so. Congenial atmosphere for bhajan exists only in the association of Sadhus, pure devotees. If you go outside, you will not find it. Our Guruvaraga knew that a situation will come in which even if a person wants to perform bhajan he will not find a proper place for that. Previously (in ancient times), it was not necessary. But they understood that those who want to worship and engage themselves for the service of Krishna and His devotees in Kaliyuga, they will need someplace. How will you know whether you are fit for performing bhajan or not? You are speaking about the material things, will God come into your mind? You are hearing about worldly things always, will God come to your mind?

lines: grāmya-kathā nā balibe, grāmya-vārtā nā śunibe

blocks.text: You are hearing just the opposite (worldly things) so those thoughts will get imbibed in the storehouse of your mind. Who will rescue you? When you remain in the company of Sadhus, even outside people may control you, “Ah! Being in Math are you smoking?” There are so many persons who do smoke but they will not say anything to them and they will come to the Acharya of the Math to complain, “Swamiji, your person is smoking.” Outside the whole world may be smoking but they will not say anything to anybody. Though, they are not devotees but they are also governing you. So here by the fruit you will understand. You will think within but not with vanity. You should remain in association of Sadhus—pure devotees. Even the highest emancipated souls—Gopa and Gopis, millions of them, they remain together and sing the glories of Supreme Lord in the emancipated state, realized state. When we shall go to the realized state, we are to do the same thing. Gradually we will get it.

There was Sankirtan Sobha-yatra (Nagar-sankirtan) performed here in Kolkata. It was introduced by our Gurudev, I am deprived because I have committed an offense, I have some difficulty in the heart, I have been told not to perform jumping, perform Kirtan loudly. If you utter loudly you are doing good to yourself and to others, all these animals, trees etc. God’s name and God are the same. They are not different. When you utter, “Krishna Krishna Krishna, Radhe Shyam” those words will touch trees, animals etc. So you should do Sankirtan, not to show to others, but as your bhajan. If you do it, it will be beneficial to you. Your mind will be sanctified. If you stay in the Math just to eat and sleep then it will be like staying in hotel. Regularly, in the morning and night and if possible in daytime we have to speak and hear Harikatha. So, Nagar-sankirtan was performed successfully and after that Krishna Janmashtami was observed. So many persons came. They observed fasting the whole day and night. Of course those who could not remain completely without taking anything, they were given fruits etc. at three a.m. in the morning after performing Maha-abhisheka. Next day of Krishna Janmashtami, Nanda Maharaj came to know that he has got a son. So there was Nandostava (a festival by Nanda Maharaj), thousands of people came and they were served. We perform a festival for the marriage ceremony of the son, daughter, by that we get attachment to the world. If you perform festival for Krishna, then you will have attachment to Krishna. At midnight we go through Krishna’s advent pastime from Srimad Bhagavat. You have to remember them. As we could not have the video conference that time as so many persons were there and there was no space so now after finishing the function at least something should be spoken to you, for that reason this video conference is arranged.

There is consciousness in Prithvi Devi. She is a demigod. Prithvi, earth, by the burden of tremendous sins and crimes of the demons, was very much in trouble and anxiety. She approached Brahma. Whenever there will be all these heinous crimes and killing without consideration, you should be ready for the consequences, anything may happen. For keeping it balanced, anything may happen anytime. For that we should be prepared. Prithvi Devi approached Brahma. Brahma said he will have to worship Vishnu. Brahma went to the shore of the ocean of milk with other demigods and performed immense penance. He ultimately heard a celestial voice—oracle. Lord Vishnu directed Brahma, “I am going to appear (on earth) so you should not be afraid. Other demigods with their wives will also appear to help me in the lineage of Pandu (Pandavas) and Yadavas. There is no reason to fear.” Then Brahma said to all the demigods that this is the order of the Supreme Lord so you should appear on the earth with your wives and then He will also appear.

Devaki, the younger sister of Kamsa, was had just got married to Vasudeva. Kamsa was very glad and wanted to drive their chariot himself. That was not necessary but he thought that, “It is my sister’s marriage so I should do that.” So he was driving the chariot with great enthusiasm. On the way he heard, “Oh Kamsa! You are taking your sister Devaki with great joy. But the eighth womb (son) of Devaki who will appear in the month of Bhadra (fifth month of Bengali calendar and middle of August to mid-September of English calendar) will kill you.” Immediately, Kamsa took hold of the hair of Devaki to kill her. His mind was changed. Then Vasudeva tried to pacify him saying, “What are you doing? You are a hero. Death is nothing. When there is birth, there will be death also. If you kill your younger sister who is like your daughter, you will earn ill fame. That will be more harmful to you. Why are you doing this?”

In this way he tried to pacify him. But Kamsa was determined to kill Devaki. Ultimately, Vasudeva said, “The celestial voice does not say that Devaki will kill you. Devaki’s eighth womb (son) will kill you. It will take time; seven births will take place first. I promise you that I shall handover to you all my sons.”

Kamsa had respect for Vasudeva as he knew that he is a Sadhu. He had the belief that whatever he says, he does. And because of that he accepted his proposal. After that what happened? When Dekavi gave birth to their first son, Vasudeva offered him to Kamsa. Kamsa was astonished to see such an act from Vasudeva. He said, “I have got no fear from your first child, I only want your eighth son. You can take him back.” Reluctantly, Vasudeva returned because he knew that mischievous persons are sometimes happy and sometimes they are not happy, there is no certainty of their words. Then Narad Muni came to Kamsa. Narad Muni travels throughout the Brahmanda. Kamsa thought, “I have the scope to know what the demigods are doing against me, I shall get all the information from Narad.” When Narad Muni goes to the demigods, demigods wanted to know about demons.

Privately, Kamsa discussed with Narad. Narad said, “I have heard that the Supreme Lord Vishnu will appear to kill you and as per the desire of Vishnu all the demigods with their wives will also appear in the family lineage of Pandavas and Yadavas.” At that time Narad Goswami warned Kamsa, “You are saying that the eighth son of Devaki will kill you, but eighth son from which side? Is it from the rear side or from the beginning of the births? (Krishna could appear in any one of the eight pregnancies) There is no certainty. And all the demigods with their wives are also coming to help Him. In your previous birth, you were Kalanemi and you were killed by Vishnu. That Vishnu is coming.”

When Narad left, Kamsa immediately thought that all the Yadavas and Pandavas are my enemies. He started oppressing them with the help of all other demons, Jarasandh, Aghasura, Bakasura etc. He immediately imprisoned Vasudeva and Devaki after chaining them in captivity, he also imprisoned his own father, Ugrasen. And so much oppression was done that all the Yadavas fled from their places. Now when Kamsa heard about not knowing which pregancy Krishna may appear from Narad Goswami, he asked Vasudeva to bring back the first child which he had returned previously. And in front of Devaki he killed that child. He killed him by striking him against the stone wall. Devaki was shocked and cried, a heart-rending cry, yet he was so cruel that in the same way he killed her six sons one by one. After that, at the time of the seventh birth, Krishna ordered Yogamaya, “You should attract the pregnancy of Devaki and take it to Gokula Mahavan to the other wife of Vasudeva, Rohini, without the knowledge of anybody. Nobody should notice this. This is my order.” And it was done, the seventh pregnancy (womb) was attracted and taken to Rohini. So Baladeva is Rohini-nandan not Devaki-nandan. He is garbha-sankarshanata-sankarshan. And that Garbha (that pregnancy) was attracted from there to Gokula Mahavan so He is named Sankarshan, Loka Ramananath, Balaram; He is giving happiness to all the Vrajavasis. He is Balaram. He is an extending personality of Krishna — sandhini-shakti-matta-vigrah. He is very powerful—Balashraya Balbhadra. After His apperance Krishna thought, “I shall appear now on the eighth of Bhadra, dark fortnight. In dark fortnight, moon will not be full, it will be a decayed moon.”

The description of His appearance is written in Srimad Bhagavatam. When there was manifestation of a very delightful, blissful time, all good qualities, all the stars, planets etc. and constellations became calm and quiet. God is coming. Every area is blissful, calm and serene. Krishna appeared in Rohini Holy Star (Rohini-nakshatra). All the ten quarters of the globe became peaceful and quiet. The sky (firmament) was spotless and adorned with stars. God who is All-Good is going to come. All the towns, cities, villages and pasture lands on earth became decorated automatically. Rivers were thoroughly filled with clear water. Lakes were adorned with various beautiful Lotuses. Forests were reverberating with the sweet voice of cuckoos and the pleasant sound of other birds and with the humming sound of bumblebees. Earth was adorned with green leaves and sweet scented flowers. When God comes everything becomes very pleasant. A pure pleasant wind was blowing. Brahmins, all of a sudden, started an oblation fire which was stopped by the demons. In this wonderful sacred environment, the Supreme Lord Bhagavan Vishnu was about to appear in the world. At that time all the sages became complacent and bright. There was the holy sound of celestial kettledrums in heaven. The Supreme Lord is going to appear. You think about this. I may leave some portion. Demigods and saints started showering flowers. When the Supreme Lord Janardan was about to appear in the dark night, there was rumbling sound of clouds. At that time like a full moon, the Supreme Lord, who resides in the hearts of all the spirit souls, appeared. ‘Gaur Premanande Hari Haribol!’
Sri Krishna appeared in the womb of sat-chid-anand form of Devaki. Vishwanath Chakraborty Thakur said in his commentary that Bhagavan was not born from the womb of Devaki like an ordinary child.

lines: āvirāsīd yathā prācyāṁ diśīndur iva puṣkalaḥ

blocks.text: You have to think about this. Supreme Lord was not born from the womb like the other persons of this world. But He appeared like the full moon in the East. How? On the eighth day a full manifestation! He appeared in the prison house with a conch shell, disc, club and lotus in His hands. Sun and Moon are not produced by the East quarters. Sun rises in the East but Eastern side is not the producer of Sun or Moon. Sun and Moon grace the East side. Like that Krishna appeared from Devaki to give them service in parental mood (love). He appeared in the dark fortnight, the eighth lunar day, of the fifth month Bhadra of Bengali calendar and mid-August to mid-September.

lines: āvirāsīd yathā prācyāṁ diśīndur iva puṣkalaḥ

blocks.text: Here, Indu means Moon. Puṣkala means full Moon. How can a full Moon come on the eighth day? Krishna appears by His own will, as the Sun and Moon rise in the East. He is not a production of Vasudeva and Devaki. First He appears in the heart of Vasudeva. After that He enters into the heart of Devaki. Devaki become very luminous due to Lord’s appearance in her heart. Beholding this, there is an infusion of fear in the heart of Kamsa, “Now the eighth son will be born and He will kill me. Oh! Devaki has become so powerful.” Kamsa, pricked by conscience, without doing any harm to Devaki, he was always thinking of the Supreme Lord out of fear with a hostile mentality. He was seeing Krishna everywhere but with hostile mentality. He always feared that Krishna will come and will kill him. His mind was engrossed in Krishna. This is one kind of bhajan. Now what had happened? Kamsa was seeing Bhagavan everywhere with a hostile spirit; meanwhile all demigods and saints came there and started singing the glories of Devaki’s womb and the glories of the Supreme Lord. They said amongst the three truths (satyam)—God, individual souls and Maya, God is the eternal truth. Individual souls are superior to gross and subtle bodies but Paramatma is far superior to individual souls and the Supreme Lord who possesses infinite opulences is the highest entity. He is the transcendental Supreme person. He is All-Existence, All-Knowledge and All-Bliss. They also sung the glories of goodness and blessedness of the surrendered souls, the necessity of descent of Supreme Lord, fearlessness of bona-fide pure devotees. Bona-fide devotees had no fear.

Sukadeva Goswami was requested by Pariksit Maharaj, “I want to hear about the appearance of Krishna and Baladeva and about what pastimes They performed.” At that time Pariksit Maharaj said I want to hear because,

Those who are emancipated souls, realized souls, they will worship Krishna correctly. Their worship is without any ulterior desires. They are worshipping Krishna for Krishna’s satisfaction. They have an inclination to hear about Him from core of their hearts. For such persons, His pastimes will enter into their heart through their ears. Nvṛtta-tarṣair upagīyamānād bhavauṣadhāc — these descriptions are medicine for those who are in the malady of births and deaths, three-fold afflictions, infirmity, vanity etc. in this world. The divine panacea for them is to hear about the glories of Sri Krishna, about His advent, name, form, attributes, personal associates and pastimes. And even those who want deliverance from the clutches of Maya, if they hear about this, they become free from the clutches of Maya. Bhavauṣadhāt — births and deaths and also threefold affliction are called 'bhavau' which will be removed. Ka uttamaśloka-guṇānuvādāt pumān virajyeta vinā paśughnāt ― Who will not listen about Krishna’s advent, holy name, form, pastimes excepting those who are killing animals? Only the animal killers will not have aptitude to listen to them. Those who are not worshipping the Supreme Lord and singing His glories are committing a kind of suicide. They will be deprived of hearing such transcendental topics. If they hear they will be rescued. When Sukadeva Goswami said to Pariksit Maharaj that, “You are hearing without taking any food, water and rest, how will you maintain your body? You should take some water some food, some rest.” Pariksit Maharaj replied, “No,

lines: naiṣātiduḥsahā kṣun māṁ tyaktodam api bādhate

blocks.text: “It is true and very difficult to tolerate the pangs of thirst and hunger but,”

‘’I shall die after some time. I have been cursed by a Brahmin, so you should not think about me. I am drinking ambrosia of the Krishna’s name, form, attributes and everything. So I have got no feeling of thirst or hunger. I do not want to take water, food or sleep.”

Can we say like this? Pariksit Maharaj said like this. Sukadeva Goswami also spoke without taking anything. Those who were there, Munis, Rishis they were also engrossed in hearing. So this, as you were not present here at the time of Krishna Janmastami, I have tried briefly to say something.

articles.title: Pastimes of Lord Sri Krishna
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Srila Gurudev narrates different pastimes of Sri Krishna at Gokul Mahavan during the braj-mandal parikrama. He speaks on brahmand-ghat lila, pastimes of killing of Putana, pastimes of stealing butter, Damodar lila and sakat bhanjan lila. He emphasizes on inner significance of these pastimes.

blocks.text: By the grace of Sri Sri Radha Gokulanand, Nand Maharaj, Yashoda devi and Krishna-Balaram and by the grace of Kshetrapal Shivji, we have got the opportunity to take part in the celebration of Gokul-Mahavan Math festival. We have got the opportunity to have darsan of their lotus feet. This is the appearance place of our most worship-able Lord Nandnandan Krishna. But just by coming here what will happen? It is written in Chaitanya Charitamrit, ‘adyapi sei lila kare krishna-ray, kono kono bhagyavane dekhibare pai—Sri Krishna is performing all His pastimes even today but the fortunate one’s only could see them.’ How a fallen person like me can see them? I have material desires in my heart. It is been said, jaha kaam tahan nahi rama, ravi, rajni mile nahi ektham—as day and night cannot exist together, if a votary has material desires in his heart, Supreme Lord does not appear there. When we have the tendency for sense enjoyment then we associate with inferior things. Even if we go to dham, we cannot have the darsan of dham, we see it like an ordinary village. Dham darsan is possible only by the eyes filled with love and not by the eyes filled with lust. Wherever there is a presence of desires to satisfy our own senses and misconception of self there Supreme Lord, His holy abode, form, qualities and associates will never manifest. It is said, "kaam andhtam, prem nirmal Bhaskar" — lust is the form of highest darkness (ignorance) and love is the form of pure brightness (represents pure knowledge). Even by coming in the dham, the whole day I am engaged in sense gratification. How can any realization of Supreme Lord be possible? This is the topmost place, appearance place of our worship-able Lord, Sri Krishna. He appears in the sanctified heart. Shivaji, "vaishnavanam yatha sambho" — the topmost amongst all the vaishnava, has said, it comes in the fourth canto of Srimad Bhagavatam, before Dhruva narration.
I offer my obeisances to the Supreme Lord Vāsudev who manifests only in the sanctified pure heart which is called Vasudev.

Lord Vāsudev appears in Mathura accepting Vasudev as father. By the help of Yogamaya, Vasudev takes Him to Gokul from Mathura and brings Yogamaya (who appeared as the daughter of Yashodadevi) from Gokul. Vāsudev Sri Krishna appears accepting Vasudev and Devaki as His parents. Who is Vasudev? Sanctified pure heart devoid of any vanity is Vasudev. He would not descend in an impure heart, because an impure heart never wants Him, it has desires other than Krishna.

Supreme Lord has performed many pastimes here (in Gokul-Mahavan), by hearing which our heart will get purified. Tomorrow we will go to have darsan of Brahmand-ghat, but there we might not get enough time to speak about the ontological aspects of Sri Krishna. Lord performs the pastime of eating clay (earth) at Brahmand-ghat. There are some teachings to be accepted from that pastime. Yashoda mata has never seen Krishna as Supreme Lord, she always considers Him as her small child. She is serving Him in vraj-bhav.
One day all the cowherd boys approached Yashodadevi and complained, “Mother, Krishna is eating clay”
She replied, “No it is not possible. He cannot eat clay, if He does so He will get many diseases, you have got no knowledge. I do not trust you; let me ask Balaram.”
Balaram said, “Yes, Yes! He is eating clay.”
“How can He eat clay? Has He got no sense, no intelligence?”

Supreme Lord has got no intelligence! If you say to Yashodadevi, “It is not that Krishna has no intelligence; it is you who have got no knowledge about your son. Your son is Supreme Personality of Godhead.” You may give proof from various scriptures. In Srimad Bhagavat Gita Krishna Himself says (7.7),

lines: mattah parataram nanyat kincid asti dhananjaya
mayi sarvam idam protam sutre mani-gana iva.

blocks.text: There is no one superior to Me. And nothing is separate from Me, everything rests upon Me, as different pearls are strung on a thread.
If you go on giving proofs, like

Krishna is the Supreme Godhead, who is the primeval Lord, the reservoir of all pleasure, Govinda, He has an eternal blissful spiritual body. He is the origin of all. He has no other origin and He is the prime cause of all causes.

If you go to teach this to Yashodadevi, then you will not get Vraj-prem (The transcendental love of Vraj). Without the grace of Yashodadevi you will not get it. She never sees Krishna in His majestic aspect.

On hearing the same from Balaram, Yashodadevi runs to Krishna and asks Him, “Have you eaten clay?” Krishna does not open-up His mouth. She chastises Him, “Open your mouth. You have no knowledge. Is clay a thing to be eaten? I shall give you a slap.” Frightened by mother’s words Krishna opens up His mouth, and Yashodadevi behold the whole Brahmanda in His small mouth. What is the teaching behind this pastime? Externally, Krishna looks like a small boy but He is the master of infinite Brahmandas and Vaikunthas. If you do not believe, you do not have any understanding of Krishna-tatva (ontological aspects of Krishna). And if you do not know Krishna-tatva, what benefits will you get by circumambulating the Dham? One who does not have understanding of Krishna-tatva, he envisions Him confined in three dimensions of this world—length, breadth and height. But within a finite form, He is infinite. Rabindranath Tagore has also said, “simara madhye asim tumi—You are infinite within the finite.” This is His inconceivable power. But so called gyanis do not understand Him, they do not have that knowledge or intelligence.

Sometimes devotees also talk like that. One day a person, disciple of our Math told me, “You are Bhagavan?” Am I Bhagavan? Who can be called as Bhagavan? 'Bhag', 'van'—one who is the possessor of the potencies. Which kind of the potencies? Not one or two but whatever potencies you can think of and those which even you cannot think of, He is the possessor of all those potencies. He is sarva-shakti-man—All-powerful. Supreme Lord Krishna has lifted Goverdhan. Previously, Govardhan was sixty-four miles long but because of the curse of Pulastya Muni, He is only of seven miles now. He would diminish in size everyday according to the measure of one sesame seed and later He would disappear from this earth planet. Lord Krishna can lift such a huge Govardhan mountain. He is All-powerful. That person told me I am Bhagavan; I cannot even lift a small stone, what kind of Bhagavan am I? He was not even feeling ashamed to talk like that.

Once devas (demigods) and asuras (demons) cooperatively set out to churn the ocean of milk, Kshirsagar, being desirous to get the nectar of immortality, amrita. They decided to use Mandara-parvat (Mandar Mountain) as the churning rod. They have got the pride that they can do anything. All of a sudden, Mandara Mountain began to sink in the Kshirsagar. That time Supreme Lord came to their rescue and lifted the Mountain on His back (shell) taking the form of a tortoise. He then ordered them to start the churning again. Although, He held such a big Mountain on His back, He did not feel any inconvenience. On the contrary, when demigods and demons rotated Mandara Mountain on His back, He accepted the rolling of the Mountain as a means of scratching His body and thus He felt a pleasing sensation and fell asleep, just like a child on scratching his back falls asleep. Supreme Lord can lift a huge Mandara Mountain on His back without any inconvenience. And what kind of Supreme Lord I am, leave aside Mandara mountain, I cannot even bare a small stone on my back. And that person was calling me Bhagavan. A jiva cannot be Supreme Lord; he is of Supreme Lord, by Supreme Lord and for Supreme Lord. Supreme Lord is Infinite Absolute Entity (vibhu), while jivas are the absolute infinitesimal or spiritual atomic parts (anu) of the marginal potency of the Absolute like the particle of the ray of the sun, which is distinct from Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. So there is always going to be difference between Supreme Lord and the jivas. Supreme Lord is full in Himself (purn), All-powerful, Omnipotent and Jivas are atomic parts of His potency. Supreme Lord is the controller of Maya (illusory potency) while Jivas are controlled by Maya. Sri Krishna says in Srimad Bhagavad Gita (7.14), daivi hy esa gun-mayi mama maya duratyaya, mam eva ye prapadyante, mayam etam taranti te—My illusory potency consisting of three primeval qualities (satva, rajah and tamah) is divine and it is extremely difficult to crossover, only one who has taken absolute shelter unto Me will get delivered.’

This material world gets created, maintained and annihilated by My illusory potency, Maya. The illusory potency of Supreme Lord gives tremendous sufferings to the jivas while they are in the womb of their mother, they stay in this word and at the time of leaving their body. Supreme Lord says, “It is My illusory potency, the divine energy of mine, jivas cannot crossover it by their own ability, but those who surrender unto Me, can easily crossover it. Whoever he may be, a brahmin, kshatriya, vaishya, shudra, antyaj (who does not even fall in the four categories) or even an animal like Gajendra.” He does not differentiate, ye prapadyante te taranti, whoever takes His shelter, He will rescue him. He is the controller of all the potencies so He can rescue. Person like me who is under the control of maya, how can I recue anybody?

Nandnadan Krishna is the Supreme Lord Himself. In Dwarka, He resides with His majestic aspects (aiswarya bhav). There He expands as primary quadruple, Vasudev, Sankarshan, Pradyumna and Aniruddha. In Dwarka, depending upon the pastime, sometimes He exhibits the mood of sweetness (gaurabha madhurya bhav). But in Vraja, He is purely in the mood of sweetness. In Vaikuntha, He is in Narayan with full of His majestic aspects. Narayan, also has expansions in the form of secondary quadruple, Vasudev, Sankarshan, Pradyumna and Aniruddha. Sankarshan in Dwarka is primary Shankarshan (mul Shankarshan) and Sankarshan in Viakuntha is called Mahasankarshan. Both are expansions of Balaram who resides in Vraja in the form of a cowherd boy. In Dwarika He is as primary Shankarshan, in the form of a kshatriya (warrior class).

Karanodkashayi Mahavishnu is the expansion of Mahasankarshan. Karanodasayi Mahavishu thought, “Ekoham bahusyam: I am one, I shall become many.” then He glanced upon the inert matter and infinite brahmandas got manifested. Karanodkasayi Mahavishnu expands Himself as second Purusha-avatar-Garbhodakasayi Vishnu and enters into all the universes. He is not the cause of Krishna, Krishna is the root cause of all the purush-avataras and everything.

The Lord possesses inconceivable supreme power, He generates innumerable universes from His body, He is the original source of all incarnations, He bestows salvation upon enemies He kills, and He has the ability to attract exalted persons who are satisfied in themselves. Although these qualities are present in Narayan, the dominating Deity of the Vaikuntha planets, they are even more wonderfully present in Krishna.

lines: atmaramas ca munayo nirgrantha apy urukrame

blocks.text: The liberated souls, who are established on the path of self-realization, though free from all kinds of material bondage, they are also attracted by Krishna’s transcendental qualities.
If the qualities of the Lord would have been material or made up of three modes of material nature, could they attract the self-realized liberated souls?

Sukadev Goswami was fully established in Brahman conception by his birth itself. As soon as he came out form the womb of his mother, renouncing everything he started running towards forest and his father (Vedavyas Muni) ran behind him calling, “Oh! Son of mine! Oh! Son of mine!” He had the highest position amongst all the yogis and gyanis. And he says to Parikshit Maharaj, “I was fully established in Brahmanand (the bliss of Brahman) which is not obtainable even by performing penance for thousands of years. And krishna-lila-rasamrit (nectar in the mellows of Krishna’s pastime) is such that, even a person like me got attracted and bound by that sweetness. So for the next seven days you should listen to Krishna-katha (subjects related to Krishna) only.”

There were many stalwarts risi-munis present there like Atri, Chavan, Brigu, Angira, Narad, Viswamitra, Vedavyas, even Lord Parshuram, Agashya who drank the full ocean. It was not the assembly of ordinary people. But nobody dared to oppose his opinion. Why was that? Because Sukadev Goswami is topmost amongst all the yogis and gyanis, also he is Mahabhagavat. Who can oppose him?

Supreme Lord is performing His pastime of playing with sakhas here. Who can have darshan of it? It is possible only through the eyes filled with love. Our Sanatan Goswami had darshan of those pastimes here at Raman-reti. He saw a distinct boy playing here in Raman-reti. We cannot have that darshan. This is transcendental land. How can we have darshan of transcendental realm with our material eyes? By the material eyes we can see only material things. To obtain the transcendental vision we need the grace of Nand Maharaj and Yashodadevi. Therefore, Mahaprabhu praised the words of Raghupati Upadhyay a lot. He met him at Vallabh Bhatta’s place at Prayag (Allahabad).

Those who are afraid of material existence may worship the sruti (gyani), smṛti (karmi) or Mahabharata, but I pay my obeisances to Nanda Maharaja because Sri Krishna, the Param Brahman, becomes trapped by the love of Sri Nanda and crawls around as a baby in his courtyard.

The Lord has killed Putana there. What is the significance of the pastime of killing of Putana. The fountain head of all the Gaudiya Mathas, Srila Sachidanand Bhaktivinod Thakur has written the implication of that pastime. Accepting Srila Bhaktivinod Thakur, appeared our Paramgurudev, Nityalila-pravistha 108 Srila Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Thakur in Jagannath Puri. It is written by Vyāsadeva in the Padma-Purāṇa, ‘hy utkale purusottamāt’, the pure message of devotion to Sree Krishna would spread out of Jagannāth Purī. When he was a baby of six months, it was the time of the Ratha-yātra festival; that year Sree Jagannāthdev stopped for three days in front of Sree Bhaktivinode Ṭhākur’s house. Those three days, Srila Thakur performed incessant kirtans day and night. The he brought the six month baby to have darshan of Jagannathdev. Jagannathdev blessed the baby with His garland. He was been given the dust of lotus feet of Lord Jagannathdev and then after only Jagannathdev started His onward journey. That transcendental personality preached the message of Krishna-bhakti throughout the entire world. Bhaktivinod Thakur is his father, who wrote the implication for the pastime of killing of Putana. Who is called Putana? Putana is kapatata—deceitfulness. Externally, she showed affection for the new born babies of Gokul Mahavan but she had bad intensions of killing them by making them suck her poisoned breast. She took the form of a beautiful lady by the power of her illusory ability and came to the house of Nand Maharaj. I will not speak the pastime today. We know that Krishna killed Putana. What does Putana signify? It represents deceitfulness. We serve the Supreme Lord for getting material benefits, for sensual enjoyments or for liberation. We do not serve Him for His satisfaction; we want dharma—piety; artha—wealth; kama—fulfilment of desires; moksha—salvation. This is deceitfulness. Till the time we have desire for enjoyment we cannot get Supreme Lord. Because of the desires of jivas, other than the service of Supreme Lord, He created so many brahmandas and so many different species. Can you even create an aunt? He says, “You are not the enjoyer. But still you have the desires to enjoy? Then go to the non-eternal world and enjoy.” Even the capacity to enjoy is not there in jivas. It is also given by Him only. You speak from your heart, “I do not want anything else except You.” You do not have that courage to speak so from your heart. Nandnandan Krishna has come accepting the mood of Radharani as Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and giving us instructions, “It is not good to have desires other than the service of Me. You do not blame Me unnecessarily. You speak from your heart, na dhanaṁ na janaṁ na sundarīṁ kavitāṁ vā jagadīśa kāmaye, mama janmani janmanīśvare bhavatād bhaktir ahaitukī tvayi —I have no desire to accumulate wealth, nor do I desire to enjoy beautiful women, nor do I want any number of followers. I only want Your (Krishna’s) causeless devotional service in my life birth after birth.”

We say anything, externally, but Supreme Lord is bhava-grahi (he knows what is there in our heart) not bhasha-grahi (he does not consider what you speak from your mouth). If Supreme Lord comes to take us to His abode we will say, “I need to make my daughter marry, I have made a new house and not yet inaugurated.”
“Then why have you called Me?”
“I have these troubles. You please solve my problems.”

We are afraid of calling Him from the core of our heart. If someone calls Nandnandan Krishna from the core of his heart He will come at that very moment. Till the time we have desires for enjoyment and liberation, Supreme Lord will be unattainable. Those desires are signifying Putana which resides in the heart. If we take shelter of Supreme Lord, He will kill her. Those who give the teachings for worldly enjoyment and for liberation, they are also Putana. If you go to them, you will not get Supreme Lord. They will guide you in the opposite direction. Krishna kills that demon Putana. So take absolute shelter unto Krishna.

When Krishna completes His six months and the first time He turns to the side, Nandbaba and Yashodamata become blissful on seeing His doing so. They decide to celebrate parshva-parivartan-mahotsava—the celebration for Krishna changing His side while lying. They call everybody for the celebration and Prasadam. They will distribute cloths to everyone and will feed them will delicious food preparations. On seeing six months Gopal, everyone gets delighted. The brahmins make Him bath reciting the appropriate Mantras. And then Gopal falls asleep. Now there are so many guests at home so where to make Him to sleep? There lies one bed beneath a bullock-driven cart. They decide to make Him sleep on that bed. The bullock-driven cart is heavily loaded with utensils and many other things. Yashodamata makes Krishna sleep on that bed. And there comes one demon named ‘Sakatasur’. He enters in the dust which is there on the cart. That time Krishna wakes up and gets very much hungry. Out of hunger He starts crying. But there is so much noise there that Yashodamata could not listen to the crying baby. Krishna starts to kick His lotus feet just like an ordinary child. And while kicking, His feet’s toe touches to one of the wheel of the cart and it gets collapsed there itself. All the utensils and other things falls there with a great noise. And seeing that Yashodamata rushes to Him crying and calling, “Gopal, Gopal..” Everyone who has come there they also rush there. They take the utensils and others things aside and from beneath take Krishna out and give Him to Yashodamata. They do not know that Krishna has killed the demon, Sakatasur. Now here, what does Sakatasur signify? He represents the worldly knowledge which is actually ignorance because of which a person carries unnecessary burden like donkey. It is said,

(All sorts of material knowledge are variegated forms of your illusory energy which creates impediments on the path of your worship. Such knowledge creates attachment for these perishable worldly relations and makes an ass out of the living entity).

We carry the impressions of this birth as well as of our previous births that makes us forget our real identity. We consider this body to be the person and the bodily relations to be ours and engage in getting non-eternal material benefits. This ignorance is the demon Satakasur. Till the time we have these impressions, material desires, the bodily conception we will not get His love. And who will kill that demon? Krishna Himself will kill that demon. Yashodamata and Nandbaba invite some Brahmins to bless Krishna. Brahmins generally have the habit of awarding blessing to others.

One of Srila Gurudev disciple, a Kashmiri Pandit, also had blessed Srila Gurudev, when he we allowed to speak at Tejpur Math. We have to ask blessings from Guru, Vaishnava and Bhagavan. But not doing so, that Brahmin, started giving blessings to Gurudev at the beginning!
Nandbaba and Yashodamata ask those Brahmins to bless Krishna so that He gets long life!

articles.title: We Must Celebrate His Advent
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Srila Paramgurudev said, "It is true there is a scarcity of rice. But, nonetheless, we see that everybody is still carrying on celebrating their own marriage ceremonies, birthday ceremonies and the like. Supreme Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the only Master and Enjoyer of these infinite brahmāṇḍas. Will there be no festival to celebrate His advent? There must be a feast tomorrow!"

blocks.text: Bhakti is very difficult for those who have no submissive tendency. They cannot perform bhakti. It is easiest for those who have the aptitude for taking shelter of the Supreme Lord and His absolute counterpart, the śuddha bhakta. The practice of bhakti is simultaneously the easiest and the most difficult process. If there should be the presence of material ego, it will render the performance of bhakti impossible. People such as Hiraṇyakaśipu and others could perform immense penances, but they could not perform bhakti. They did not want to give up their ego, their vanity. We are a part of the potency of the Supreme Lord, but we are not the Supreme Lord. Why is it that we have become jīvās and received this conditioned state, encountering all kinds of difficulties as we pass through countless births and deaths? Would God pass through births and deaths? Obviously, we are not God, the Supreme Lord. We are a part of His potency. We have committed an offense and forgotten our real position. For this reason, the illusory energy has enveloped us and we have assumed these false egos. If we wish to perform pure devotion, then we have to give up these false egos.

During the time of our Guru Mahārāja (Śrīla Bhakti Dayita Mādhava Gosvāmī Mahārāja), a Janmāṣṭamī celebration occurred when there was a scarcity of rice. Even householders could not donate rice to the Maṭh. So, we could take rice at only one meal a day. At the other meals we would take wheat and pound it together with mung dal into a mixture to make a khichadi—a hodgepodge. Ordinarily, khichadi is made with rice and dal, not wheat. Those were difficult times. But then, every institution declared that they would not be distributing khichadi during Janmāṣṭamī, as there was no rice. Generally, we would make a large amount of khichadi—it is very easy to prepare—and distribute it to thousands of people. But at that time, there was no rice. We appealed to Guru Mahārāja, “Please announce at tonight’s Janmāṣṭamī celebration that we will not be celebrating the usual festival with distribution of khichadi to all tomorrow. Instead, every institution will give sweets instead of khichadi.” Guru Mahārāja said, “Alright, alright.”

That evening, at the Janmāṣṭamī function, many distinguished Vaiṣṇavas spoke till about 10:30 PM. At around 11 PM, Guru Mahārāja began his discourse on the chapter of the advent of Śrī Kṛṣṇa from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam. After he completed his lecture, he announced, “There will now be abhiṣeka for Kṛṣṇa’s advent time at midnight. After that, there will be pūjā, followed by bhoga-rāga. Today, we are observing a fast and may only take some fruits. Tomorrow, Nanda Mahārāja will come to know that he has a Son! So, he will be very glad, and will distribute prasādam. So, I invite all of you to come again tomorrow and we shall feed you.”

The devotees were astounded. “How can this be? We have no rice!” They knew very well that, in Bengal, if one person were invited, he would bring ten others. So, one thousand invitees instantly become ten thousand. They were quite perturbed.
Guru Mahārāja went to his room and many of us followed. We asked him, “How can we feed all these people tomorrow? We have no rice.”

Then Guru Mahārāja declared, “It is true there is a scarcity of rice. But, nonetheless, we see that everybody is still carrying on celebrating their own marriage ceremonies, birthday ceremonies and the like. Supreme Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the only Master and Enjoyer of these infinite brahmāṇḍas. Will there be no festival to celebrate His advent? There must be a feast tomorrow!”
I do not know who sent rice, but the next day there was a huge function and all were fed with khichadi. From where had it come? Who had sent it? We do not have this sort of faith.

articles.title: Sanctifying the Hearts
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: ‘Adhivāsa’ means that we have some prior duty to perform before His appearance, so that we will be ready for Him. We have to sanctify our hearts so that Krishna can appear there. Krishna is already there, but we are not aware of His presence.

blocks.text: Our Most Revered Gurudeva, Nityalīlā Praviṣṭa Oṁ Viṣṇupāda Śrī Śrīmad Bhakti Dayita Mādhava Gosvāmī Mahārāja, Founder/President of Śrī Chaitanya Gaudiya Math institution, established this Kolkata Math, and his objects of worship, Śrī Śrī Guru-Gaurāṅga-Rādhā-Nayananātha Jīu, appeared here by dint of his devotion. He installed the Deities during the winter season. Thereafter, our Gurudeva introduced two five-day religious meetings in the Kolkata Math, to celebrate the occasions of the anniversary of the installation of the Deities and Śrī Krishna Janmāṣṭamī, the advent anniversary of Śrī Krishna. At that time, when he was living on this earth, we were under him directly, so we had no worries. Whatever he directed was directed by Supreme Lord Śrī Krishna. Gurudeva is the absolute counterpart of the Supreme Lord, and we were not to be worried. But, after his disappearance, we could not see him physically although, indirectly, he was still directing everything. As God is eternal, His absolute counterpart is also eternal.

As long as there is the sun, the light of the sun, the quality of the sun will also be there. If the sun is eternal, its light will also be eternal. Like that, the Supreme Lord is the Supreme Eternal Entity and, therefore, His absolute counterpart is also eternal. He is grace incarnate. He graces all the deserving enslaved jīvās of this world.

By the grace of the Supreme Lord, we can see that His grace incarnate is the bonafide guru, His personal associate. Gurudeva, the grace incarnate of Supreme Lord Śrī Krishna Gaurāṅga Mahāprabhu, appeared and put his holy footprints in our own place. I had no knowledge of Gaudiya Math, but he attracted me. He is the expansion of Chaitanya Mahāprabhu. Chaitanya Mahāprabhu sent His own personal associate here. Gurudeva also went to many different places and rescued many fallen souls. We have to remember Gurudeva. Without his race, without submission to him, without sincere belief in him, we cannot have any kind of contact with Krishna.
Throughout the infinite planets, you will find all the pastimes of Śrī Krishna going on continuously, one after another. In this sense, His appearance pastime is eternal:

There are infinite brahmāṇḍas and infinite planets—so many that we cannot even conceive of them. Somewhere within these brahmāṇḍas, He is appearing continuously. So, in this sense, His appearance is eternal. But He also appears, reveals Himself, in the sanctified heart of the śuddha bhakta. This is also His eternal appearance. We have to prepare ourselves so that Krishna will think us to be qualified to get Him. Then He will appear in our hearts. Today is the day before

Janmāṣṭamī—“adhivāsa”. “Adhivāsa” means that we have some prior duty to perform before His appearance, so that we will be ready for Him. We have to sanctify our hearts so that Krishna can appear there. Krishna is already there, but we are not aware of His presence.

Supreme Lord Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu wrote this verse thereby instructing us how to attain the association of Krishna. How can Krishna appear in us? What do we have to do? “Śrī-Krishna-saṅkīrtanam”: chant the Holy Names of Śrī-Krishna. Then you will get everything. “You do not need to do anything to purify your mind, except to go on chanting ‘Rādhā-Krishna’, Hare Krishna mahāmantra. Everything will come to you.” We say this repeatedly with our words but, in practice, we have no belief.

The Supreme Lord will descend into our hearts—will be revealed in our hearts—when we actually and sincerely take absolute shelter at His lotus feet. He will reveal Himself to the surrendered soul. If we chant with bonafide submission, we will find that everything is there in the Holy Name—Form, attributes, everything. The Name is saccidānanda. Krishna is saccidānanda. This realization will descend into our hearts. We might think that we will get Him by our own capacity, but He is not subservient to us. He is Self-effulgent, Self-luminous like the sun.

Svāmī Mahārāja (Śrīla A. C. Bhaktivedanta Svāmī Mahārāja) used to say, “If one is enlightened by that knowledge by which ignorance is destroyed, then that knowledge reveals everything, just as the sun illuminates everything at daybreak.”

When the sun rises, he shows himself and everything else in proper perspective. We think harināma to be material sound and that we can get Krishna by our own capacity. No! If we submit to God and His absolute counterpart, then all will be revealed.

We cannot bribe the Supreme Lord. Everything is within Him, there is nothing outside Him. Dhruva Mahārāja received the grace of the Supreme Lord. We are uttering the Name and we are not getting this grace. Why? “He is not gracing us!” we complain. No, no. The sun is giving light to all. It is shining in the filthy place, the clean place—everywhere. Some are taking advantage of it, but the majority is not. Nonetheless, we complain, “The sun is not blessing us.”

Dhruva had firm belief. His faith was without a trace of doubt. “My mother told me that, by crying the Name of Śrī Hari, I shall get Śrī Hari.” He was crying, crying, crying continuously. We are not doing this. He was continuously uttering the Holy Name, completely absorbed in Hari and, whatever he saw, whether a lion, crocodile or any other beast, he embraced. They did no harm to him as he was protected from all danger. However, we have difficulty believing this. Ultimately, he received the grace of Nārada Gosvāmī.

That was an example from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam but, in this Kali-yuga, when we were once in Punjab, a very astounding event took place. A devotee woman was traveling by rickshaw from her shop to a remote place, about two miles away.
She was wearing many gold ornaments. She traveled for some time along the well populated road when suddenly the rickshaw driver turned away from the main road, toward a field.
“Why are you going across this field?” the lady protested. “That is the way, over there.”
“No,” the rickshaw driver said, “I am taking a shortcut. We will go this way.” He would not heed the woman’s words.

Then, the woman became afraid, thinking, “I am wearing so many golden ornaments. The driver must be greedy for them. He will rob me and kill me.” For this reason, she jumped from the rickshaw and started to run away, shouting, “Hah Govinda! Hah Govinda!” This is fact. We were there at the time. To save herself, she jumped into a well. In terror, she remained in the well throughout the night, all the time uttering, “Hah Govinda!” At dawn, the next morning, many people from the village came for their morning walk. They heard the sound of a woman’s voice uttering the Holy Name. “What is this?” they asked. They followed the voice to the well and found the woman who was crying, “Hah Govinda! Hah Govinda!” An extremely poisonous snake was swimming around her, circling her. “What is this?” they wondered.

Then, they saw the rickshaw. A man holding a dagger lay next to it—dead. A great cry rose from the crowd and many people gathered from different places to see what had happened. By now, it was daylight and, as people came to the woman’s aid, the snake left.

All the witnesses at the scene said they had never seen that snake before and, since that time, they have never seen it again. When the rickshaw driver went to kill the woman with his dagger, the snake bit him and injected him with venom, killing him instantly. After that, the same snake protected the woman throughout the night by circling her, so that no one could come near. The woman had firm belief. She did not utter any other name, only, “Govinda! Govinda! Govinda!”
Even in this Kali-yuga, you can find such an event. Therefore, you should have belief.

Janmāṣṭamī and other auspicious functions at the Math are “hari-smaraṇamahoṭsava” (grand celebrations dedicated to the remembrance of Hari). You will find, in a certain hymn, that the entire purpose of performing bhajana is to remember Krishna. We shall destroy all evil thoughts by remembering Krishna. We shall get everything by remembering. But, it is said in the scripture called Vaiṣṇava Cintāmaṇi, that it is not easy to remember, to meditate, with this material mind. It is very difficult. All the sins, vices and evil thoughts will be destroyed by remembrance of Krishna, but it is not so easy. But we can remember Krishna if we utilize our lips to utter His Name. By moving these lips, we can obtain eternal benefit, but, unfortunately, we have no aptitude for this. We cannot remember Krishna by means of the material mind.

When we are able to remember Krishna by loudly and continuously performing harināma, and that remembrance is revealed in our hearts, then we will be entitled to perform bhajana in a secluded place, but not now. Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu is teaching us. Our Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura is teaching us.

If our Gurudeva ever saw some devotees dancing and chanting the Holy Name, he would show them great respect. “They are expressing their hearts! Hari bol!” In order to gain some respect, name and fame, I was also dancing. “Ah! Very good!” Gurudeva would say. He would be pleased with me, although I was doing it to receive praise. Inside, I had no feeling, no want for Krishna, and no perturbation of heart. I did it only to get respect from others. Nonetheless, Gurudeva was so satisfied. Why? This you have to understand. “Kīrtana prabhāve smarana haībe” (Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura). Remembrance of Bhagavān comes from constant chanting of the Holy Name.

Prahalāda told all the demon boys, “Why are you afraid? There is no difficulty in worshipping Krishna. You should just utter the Name. You are calling your father and your mother without difficulty. Call Him and He will be satisfied. There is no difficulty. He is within you. He has affection for you. You will find the affection of crores of mothers in Śrī Hari.” Here in this world, one always encounters difficulty when trying to please another person, but Krishna is not at all difficult to please. With a sincere heart, utter His Name.

In your household life, you wile away the time for nothing, for worldly things. If you are also gossiping about these things here in the temple, then why have you come? The temple is for the worship of Krishna, nothing else. You should think about this.
Why have you come here? Have you spent so much money to come here only to gossip about worldly things? What is bhagavān-bhajana?
